meta.title: WeCom Source
meta.description: Direct WeCom source: a self-built app in callback mode receives app-chat and group-@ messages; replies return via the WeCom OpenAPI. Callbacks are signed+encrypted and deduped by MsgId; sendAck receipts are optional. Needs a callback URL on 80/443 with Token and 43-char EncodingAESKey; members must be whitelisted.
